# Font Awesome 5 Free module assets

## 2026-11-23 — Shared annotation icons
Unmodified Font Awesome Free 5.15.4 base and solid CSS, solid font formats and upstream LICENSE.txt are bundled here as the single module-owned icon integration. The version/copyright headers in the CSS identify upstream Font Awesome (https://fontawesome.com). Keep the upstream files and license together; change command presentation in css/source-viewer.css and the annotation controller, not these generated/minified vendor assets. No authored CSS/JS behavior is hidden in this directory.

Validation: SourceAnnotations.cjs verifies the 5.15.4 header, shared imports, existence of every solid CSS font URL target and license. Managed-browser fixture screenshots verify actual Add/Edit/Save/Remove/Cancel/Send glyph rendering. These assets have not yet been activated on staging.
